newsitem.title: USA: Trinity, N.C., voters opt to incorporate city.
newsitem.headline: Trinity, N.C., voters opt to incorporate city.

text.p: Residents of Trinity, N.C., voted overwhelmingly to incorporate their Randolph County community as a city, elections officials said.
The proposal passed 823-270 in Tuesday's election.
With 13,000 residents, Trinity becomes Randolph County's second largest municipality behind Asheboro.

A seven-member incorporation steering committee will serve as an interim city council until a mayor and council members are elected in November. They are to be sworn in on Friday and will immediately begin drafting a budget and setting a tax rate.
